title: The telegram: “avise Bartolomeu pode tratar assunto … novo entendimento Vivila”
caption: The text of GV c 1946.03.09/2 as transcribed from the CPDOC image, with the typed code list GV c 1946/1950.00.00/5 applied (scripts/decrypt.py, key_frozen.tsv, no correction). Most words are plain Portuguese; BARTOLOMEU is on the list (H. Borghi); VIVILA, boxed in ink on the form, is on no list.
key_note: An open code: cover words for people, parties and offices, 25 typed pairs on the filed list. The words are shown whole; nothing is spelled out letter by letter.

tokens.p: PODE TRATAR ASSUNTO SEM ASSUMIR COMPROMISSO PT ESTE DEPENDERA NOVO ENTENDIMENTO
